prompt: What is a JPanel used for in Swing?
choices: It is the only container that can hold components
It is a general-purpose container used to group and lay out components within a frame
It is the top-level window that appears in the taskbar
explanation: JPanel is a lightweight container you can nest inside JFrame or other JPanels. It has its own layout manager (default: FlowLayout). Use multiple JPanels to create complex UIs by composing panels with different layout managers.
